items.exampleEn: The chef executed each dish with great care.
items.exampleZh: 主廚非常用心地完成每一道菜。

items.exampleEn: Volunteers counted every ballot by hand late into the night.
items.exampleZh: 志工們徹夜用人工清點每一張選票。

items.exampleEn: Fighting corruption starts with clear rules about how money is spent.
items.exampleZh: 打擊貪腐要從訂定清楚的花錢規則開始。

items.exampleEn: In the story, the rebels hide in the forest and fight against a cruel king.
items.exampleZh: 在那個故事裡，反叛者躲在森林裡，對抗一位殘酷的國王。

items.exampleEn: Each juror listened carefully to every witness in the TV drama.
items.exampleZh: 那部電視劇裡，每位陪審員都仔細聆聽每個證人的證詞。

items.exampleEn: The company's nominee for the new manager job has worked here for twenty years.
items.exampleZh: 公司提名的新經理人選已經在這裡工作二十年了。

items.exampleEn: The teacher condemned the students' rude comments about the new girl.
items.exampleZh: 老師譴責了學生們對新來女同學的無禮言論。

items.exampleEn: The dancer's execution of the difficult jump was perfect.
items.exampleZh: 那位舞者把高難度的跳躍動作完成得非常完美。

items.sentenceEn: The nominees for best film will be announced next Monday.
items.sentenceZh: 最佳影片的入圍名單將在下週一揭曉。

items.audioEn: Please fold your ballot once and drop it in the box by the door.
items.audioZh: 請把選票對摺一次，投進門邊的箱子裡。

items.sentenceEn: The newspaper reported a case of corruption in the city's building office.
items.sentenceZh: 報紙報導了市府建管處的一起貪腐案。

items.sentenceEn: Good planning is easy, but execution is hard.
items.sentenceZh: 做好計畫很容易，執行卻很難。

items.stemEn: The ____ was asked not to read news about the case until the trial ended.
items.stemZh: 陪審員被要求在審判結束前不要看有關這個案子的新聞。

items.stemEn: Two workers agreed to ____ in court about what they saw.
items.stemZh: 兩位員工同意出庭，就他們看到的事作證。

items.passageEn: Our school's film club held its yearly awards night last Friday. Each member got a ballot to vote for the best short film, and there were four nominees. One film told the story of a young rebel who refused to follow her family's plans. Another, a mystery, showed a juror who discovers corruption in a small town. The judges praised the clever ideas but said none of the films was a masterpiece yet, because the execution of some was weak. In the end, the winning team said they had executed their plan by meeting every day for a month. Everyone agreed it was an unforgettable night.
items.passageZh: 我們學校的電影社上週五舉辦了年度頒獎之夜。每位社員都拿到一張選票，投給最佳短片，共有四部入圍。其中一部片講一個年輕叛逆者拒絕照家人的安排走的故事。另一部是推理片，描述一位陪審員發現小鎮裡的貪腐。評審稱讚這些點子很聰明，但也說還沒有一部稱得上傑作，因為有些片子執行得不夠好。最後，獲勝的團隊說，他們靠著一個月每天開會才把計畫執行出來。大家都覺得那是個難忘的夜晚。

questions.questionZh: 評審對有些片子的評價是什麼？
獲勝團隊說他們怎麼完成計畫？
options: 請一位專業導演來幫忙

items.promptZh: 很多居民譴責那間工廠汙染河流。
referenceEn: Many residents condemned the factory for polluting the river.
Many people living nearby condemned the factory for making the river dirty.
rubricZh: condemn 的用法，例如 condemn someone for…、condemn the factory's pollution 等

items.instructionZh: 用 execute 造一個句子，說說你怎麼執行一個計畫（例如讀書、旅行或工作計畫）。
referenceEn: I executed my study plan by reviewing one chapter every night.
I executed my travel plan step by step, and the trip went well.
